answer: The opal schedule is applied in pulse and tide shows each instalment. An attacker thus cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split so that 56% arrives at settlement and the rest over 5 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 4509 identities would post 1613 proofs and burn roughly 4 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
